properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge both response valids must be clear. After 128 consecutive reset-free, no-offer, both-ready cycles, tracked input and response obligations must be drained. Input readiness is not prescribed.
A blocked data presentation retains valid, byte and last across each subsequent edge unless that edge resets the controller.
A blocked status presentation retains valid and all four status fields across each subsequent edge unless reset cancels it.

Every valid data presentation, including blocked presentations, is justified by an already accepted input prefix or completed-frame zero padding, preserving byte and frame order and retaining only the first eight input bytes.

Every valid data presentation has the correct final-byte flag for the clamped frame length. Incomplete prefixes cannot terminate before the eighth byte; completed frames terminate exactly at their adjusted length.

Every valid status independently describes the next completed accepted input frame, with exact original length, length clamped to four through eight, and correct padding and truncation flags. Reset discards both channel queues.
